site_program: Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Holkar Government Medical College/Women Hospital, Baramati
screening_population: hospital-born neonates in postnatal ward or NICU; <32 weeks excluded; prenatal CHD excluded
screening_timing_raw: screened <24 h and again >24 h; persistent abnormality rechecked within 2 h
screening_algorithm_raw: pre/postductal <95% or >3% difference abnormal; persistent abnormality after >24 h/recheck = final positive; final positives referred for echo
study_target_definition_raw: source CCHD plus PPHN/RDS disease-positive framework
diagnosis_categories_raw: source CCHD; PPHN; RDS; source false positives
diagnosis_counts_raw: CCHD4 = TOF2 + TGA1 + TAPVR1; PPHN9; RDS26; source false positive26
individual_diagnoses: TOF x2; standalone TGA x1; TAPVR x1; PPHN x9; RDS x26; 26 disease-unclassified source false positives
lesion_mapping_status: Standalone TGA1 is definite harmonized CCHD and removed. TOF2 and TAPVR1 are conditional lesions; no participant-level <=28-day surgery/catheterization/death qualifier is documented, so all three remain in the harmonized-negative denominator.
management_actionability_evidence: All source-CCHD and PPHN cases were promptly referred to higher medical centers for further treatment; RDS cases with persistent positive screens received immediate NICU admission and oxygen/CPAP. Therefore the three re-entered cardiac cases + PPHN9 + RDS26 meet acute actionability -> CAN-A38. The 26 source false positives lack etiologic diagnosis/outcome classification -> UNKNOWN26.
poolability_reason: mixed postnatal/NICU setting is inseparable and only 38/64 harmonized-negative final fails are clinically classifiable
source_full_text_provenance: Gaonkar PM et al. Cureus. 2024;16(4):e58398. PMID 38756257; PMCID PMC11097288; DOI 10.7759/cureus.58398. Open-access full text independently reverified; PDF screenshot attempts failed because of source cache/anti-bot issues, while machine-readable primary text was available.
extraction_notes: Strict38/64; Expanded38/64; UNKNOWN26. Mixed setting independently prevents principal pooling despite exact denominator.

site_program: Hidalgo State neonatal cardiac screening pilot, Pachuca General Hospital + Obstetrics Hospital
screening_population: routine newborn screening in two public hospitals
screening_algorithm_raw: serial pulse oximetry with echo for persistent/immediate positives
study_target_definition_raw: source reports 3 screen-detected CCHD plus 1 clinically detected non-screened CCHD
diagnosis_categories_raw: simple CHD; screen-detected complex CCHD; echo without CHD
diagnosis_counts_raw: 29 screen positives -> simple CHD14 + source CCHD3 + no CHD on echo12; separate fourth CCHD was clinically identified without screening
individual_diagnoses: screen-positive source-CCHD cases include HLHS-equivalent complex (LV hypoplasia + mitral/aortic atresia + hypoplastic arch), tricuspid atresia+ASD, and TOF; clinically identified non-screened case = PA+PDA+severe TR
lesion_mapping_status: HLHS-equivalent anatomy is reproducibly harmonized CCHD and removed. Tricuspid atresia is not automatic target. TOF is conditional and the source does not document the palliative operation specifically as occurring <=28 days, so it remains in denominator. The fourth source CCHD had no screening and never enters the final-fail denominator.
management_actionability_evidence: The two re-entered complex cardiac cases underwent palliative operation -> CAN-AB2. The 14 simple-heart-disease cases are explicitly maintained in cardiology follow-up by the program -> CAN-B14. The remaining 12 are only echo-negative/no-CHD and lack noncardiac outcome ascertainment -> UNKNOWN12.
entry_hold_reason: Phase4 entry discrepancy resolved: fourth CCHD was clinically identified without screening; detailed screen-positive flow governs
poolability_reason: entry hold resolved, but terminal clinical ascertainment is 16/28 (57.1%), below principal threshold
source_full_text_provenance: Atitlán-Gil A et al. Arch Cardiol Mex. 2020;90(1):35-41. DOI 10.24875/ACM.M20000084. Primary SciELO full text independently reverified.
extraction_notes: Strict16/28; Expanded16/28; UNKNOWN12. Abstract 13.8% CCHD reflects four total CCHD in the program, but one was clinically detected and not screened. No arithmetic conflict remains in the 29 screen-positive flow.

screening_algorithm_raw: persistent SpO2 <90% after three measurements or pre/postductal difference >3% -> positive and echo
study_target_definition_raw: critical CHD screening; no CCHD found
diagnosis_categories_raw: normal echo; PFO; PFO+mild pulmonary insufficiency; PDA; ASD; ASD+PDA; ASD+rhythm disorder; ASD+false tendon; minimal MR
diagnosis_counts_raw: published full text: 53 positives, echo performed in 49; detailed same-cohort table among 49 = normal9, PFO2, PFO+mild PI1, PDA3, ASD23, ASD+PDA6, ASD+rhythm disorder2, ASD+false tendon2, minimal MR1; no CCHD
individual_diagnoses: ASD23; ASD+PDA6; PDA3; PFO2; PFO+mild PI1; ASD+rhythm disorder2; ASD+false tendon2; minimal MR1; normal echo9; no echo4
lesion_mapping_status: No harmonized CCHD. Minor ASD/PDA/PFO/minimal-regurgitation/incidental tendon findings without qualifying consequence are NON_CAN38. The two unspecified rhythm-disorder cases are clinically relevant but lack demonstrated actionability -> CAN-U2.
management_actionability_evidence: The article argues that noncyanotic CHD merits follow-up in general, but does not document a qualifying participant-level management consequence for these screen-positive findings. Normal echo9 is not global healthy/no-diagnosis; no-echo4 is also UNKNOWN.
poolability_reason: high-altitude cohort is clinically valuable but only 40/53 final positives have a classifiable non-CCHD terminal category under the locked rules

Published full-text snippets and the same-cohort 2014 Universidad Central del Ecuador primary thesis were independently reverified; PDF screenshot retrieval timed out/was blocked.

screening_population: consecutive newborns >34 weeks and >2000 g in rooming-in or basic neonatal care; prenatal CCHD excluded
screening_algorithm_raw: AAP-style pre/postductal algorithm; persistent borderline abnormality after repeat -> positive and inpatient echo
study_target_definition_raw: cyanotic critical CHD target; no CCHD detected
expanded_can_cchd_n: not point-identifiable; upper bound depends on lesion/actionability overlap
diagnosis_categories_raw: noncritical CHD by composite abnormal-echo endpoint; PFO; PDA; pulmonary hypertension; ASD; VSD; partial anomalous pulmonary venous connection; noncardiac hospitalizations
diagnosis_counts_raw: 42 pulse-positive; 29/42 classified by authors as noncritical-CHD true positives using any abnormal echo as outcome; across 53 total echos findings overlap: ASD3, VSD1, PAPVC1, PFO36, PDA24, PH5; 12/609 hospitalized for sepsis/sepsis risk/hypoglycemia/hyperbilirubinemia but positive-screen linkage not reported
individual_diagnoses: participant-level lesion composition of the 29 pulse-positive abnormal echos not reported
lesion_mapping_status: No CCHD. The exact 29 abnormal-echo positives cannot be mapped to CAN-U because the study outcome deliberately counts physiologic PFO/PDA and potentially relevant lesions together, without participant-level decomposition.
management_actionability_evidence: Noncardiac hospitalization is a qualifying clinical consequence, but the 12 hospitalized infants are reported for the full 609-neonate cohort and cannot be assigned to the 42 positive screens. Therefore Strict is bounded 0-12 rather than imputed. The 29 abnormal-echo cases cannot be converted into an Expanded numerator because their lesion/actionability composition and overlap with any noncardiac hospitalization are unknown.
poolability_reason: exact denominator 42 but neither Strict nor Expanded CAN-CCHD numerator is point-identifiable; retain only for bounded/structural sensitivity analyses
source_full_text_provenance: Rendón Díez M et al. Andes Pediatr. 2025;96(2):200-208. DOI 10.32641/andespediatr.v96i2.5374. Primary SciELO HTML full text independently reverified; publisher PDF access was blocked by anti-bot validation.
extraction_notes: Exact denominator=42, harmonized CCHD=0. Strict admissible range 0-12 based only on full-cohort hospitalization maximum; Expanded remains non-point-identifiable because 29 author-defined noncritical-CHD positives mix PFO/PDA/PH/structural lesions and participant overlap is unavailable. Do not treat 'false positives rentables' as a CAN category.
